messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx and latency spike observed on Dedicated pool `dedicated-eu-prod`. p99 latency 2.8s (baseline ~120ms), error rate 4.7% over last 3m. Paging @oncall-alex :rotating_light:

oncall-alex: Got it, seeing alerts. Are we currently hitting autoscale limits or burst cap? Any immediate customer-facing impact?

platform-jordan: quick summary from metrics: pool is at 100% reserved GPU utilization, queue length up, autoscaler did not spin extra nodes due to burst capacity flag disabled after last maintenance. A bunch of small tenants spiked concurrently.

sre-maya: Can we enable burst capacity for the pool? That should allow extra allocation for the next ~10m while we triage.

oncall-alex: +1 to burst. Also think about short-term rate limiting for very high-QPS API keys. Support: who are top talkers?

support-sam: Pulling top 10 API keys now. Early look: 3 customers account for ~55% of the surge — sandbox + two production customers (acct-72, acct-112).

platform-jordan: I can toggle burst. Runbook: <https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/dedicated-autoscale> 
Command (run from ops bastion):
```
# enable 2x burst for pool
rwctl pools set-burst --pool dedicated-eu-prod --multiplier 2 --duration 600
# temporarily relax autoscale cooldown
rwctl pools set-autoscale --pool dedicated-eu-prod --min 3 --max 12 --cooldown 30
```
Caveats: enabling burst may push costs; also need to monitor for upstream overload.

sre-maya: I'm on it. Will run the commands and watch. tagging @platform-jordan for rollback help.

incident-bot: Action accepted: `rwctl` job queued (job id: 0x7fa1). Notifying audit channel.

sre-maya: executed commands. Burst multiplier 2 applied, autoscale max increased to 12. Observability: queue length dropping, p95 latency improving. 5xx rate down to ~1.2%.

support-sam: Noting impacted customers for potential outreach: acct-72 (prod payments), acct-112 (analytics). Recommend immediate quota throttle on acct-72 to protect platform if they continue spike.

oncall-alex: Apply soft quota: reduce acct-72 QPS by 50% for 20 minutes. Use rate-limiter rule so we can revert automatically.

platform-jordan: Command to apply soft quota:
```
rwctl quotas set --customer acct-72 --qps 50 --ttl 1200 --reason "mitigation: surge"
```
Applying now.

incident-bot: Quota update completed for acct-72. 

customer-ops-lia: Preparing status page note: "We are experiencing degraded performance in EU. We have enabled burst capacity and applied short-term protections for high-volume customers. Services are stabilizing." Should we call out the two affected customers by name?

support-sam: Don't name customers publicly. Offer targeted outbound email if they want details.

oncall-alex: Agreed. Lia, publish a mitigation update without customer names and flag for follow-up.

sre-maya: Handing primary on-call to me for the next 30m while I keep watch on autoscale metrics. Alex: do you want full handoff?

oncall-alex: Handoff ack. I'm available if needed but switching to advisory. Please record exact timestamps and actions for the postmortem.

platform-jordan: Monitoring checklist: 1) p99 < 400ms, 2) 5xx < 0.5% sustained, 3) queue length stable, 4) autoscale not oscillating. If we hit autoscale > 10 nodes, we should consider routing lower-priority traffic to fallback models.

sre-maya: Currently p99 ~340ms, 5xx 0.7%. Autoscale at 6/12. Queue dropping. No oscillation yet.

incident-bot: Note: temporary mitigations in place: burst=2x (expires in 10m), acct-72 QPS reduced, autoscale max=12.

support-sam: I'll open a shielded support thread to notify acct-72 and acct-112 via existing CSMs.

customer-ops-lia: Status page updated. Email templates queued.

platform-jordan: Next steps: after stabilization, revert burst flag and quota TTL expiry will revert acct-72 automatically. Create an action item: evaluate autoscaler config — lower cooldown, smarter scale-up policy per pool.

sre-maya: Agree. I'll create a ticket and start root cause diagnostics (logs, model hot-sharding, request patterns).

oncall-alex: Thanks team. If metrics remain stable for 20m, I'll close this thread. Otherwise, escalate to infra lead. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Pinned actions: `enable-burst`, `quota-throttle acct-72`, `increase-autoscale-max`.

sre-maya: 20m check-in: stable. p99 280ms, 5xx 0.3%. Leaving burst enabled for full TTL then revert. Closing handoff to Alex once burst removed.

oncall-alex: Closing after burst reverts. Please add postmortem with timeline and cost impact.

sre-maya: Will do. Adding logs and rwctl command history to ticket. :white_check_mark:
